title: Length of a padded bit string
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $v$, if the binary expansion of $v$ has length at most $w$, then the bit string obtained by appending enough zeros to that expansion to reach length $w$ has length exactly $w$.
hypotheses_covered: The binary expansion of v has length at most w
